stories.headline: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Following Espionage Scandal
stories.summary: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive, less than two weeks after his resignation. Huang had previously stepped down following an alleged spy scandal involving a woman suspected of intelligence ties to China. His return followed discussions involving US President Donald Trump and senior government officials, though the decision drew criticism from US lawmakers.

stories.headline: Ousted Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina Plans December Return
stories.summary: Ousted Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh from India on December 16. Hasina's spokesperson stated she aims to return on a state carrier, while the Bangladeshi government maintains she can only return through extradition and vows to arrest her. Hasina has been in exile in India since an uprising in August 2024 and was sentenced to death in absentia last year.
